desc: Made from 17-4 heat-treated stainless steel and finished with a rugged PVD coating, the Tyrant Sig Sauer P365 Safety lever is built to withstand the rigors of consistent use while resisting corrosion and wear. Its extended arms are 2mm longer than the OEM design, featuring grooved serrations for a non-slip grip under adverse conditions. Tyrant's complete assembly kit is sold with a stainless steel safety plunger and spring, ensuring a seamless installation process without the need for additional parts. Compatible with the Sig Sauer P365, P365X, P365XL, P365 Macro, and Tyrant CNC P365 grip modules in both 9mm and .380 Auto calibers, this safety lever enhances your firearm's ergonomics for unmatched shooting precision.
